rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 7 sets the procedure for the Chairman: after consultations with representatives of the constituent entities and deputies' factions, the President is to submit to the Congress on 14 December 1992 several candidacies for the post of Chairman of the Council of Ministers for a 'soft' rating vote; he then presents for the Seventh Congress's approval one of the three candidates with the most votes; if the candidate is not approved, the President appoints an acting Chairman until the Eighth Congress. Point 9 makes the points inseparable. Signed 'Р.И.ХАСБУЛАТОВ', 12 December 1992, N 4079-I.
